# Purple Blaq Media

> Purple Blaq Media is a South African digital technology company based in Vanderbijlpark, Gauteng. It designs, develops, implements and supports workflow systems and business applications for organisations across South Africa.

## Official website

- https://purpleblaq.co.za/
- Contact: https://purpleblaq.co.za/contact
- Email: deon@blaqmedia.co.za
- Location: Vanderbijlpark, Gauteng, South Africa
- Service area: South Africa

## Public page overview

- [Home](https://purpleblaq.co.za/): Company overview, featured services, clients and approach.
- [Services](https://purpleblaq.co.za/services): Workflow systems, web applications, process digitisation and ongoing technology support.
- [Approach](https://purpleblaq.co.za/approach): Six-step delivery process: understand, map, build, implement, support and improve.
- [About](https://purpleblaq.co.za/about): Company background, team and commitments.
- [Contact](https://purpleblaq.co.za/contact): Enquiry form and published contact details.

## Services

- Workflow systems: Internal workflows, approvals, document management, tasks, portals, reporting, notifications and digital records.
- Web applications: Custom web applications with user accounts, dashboards, databases, forms, workflow stages, reporting and integrations.
- Process digitisation: Replacing email, WhatsApp, spreadsheets and paper-based processes with structured digital processes.
- Ongoing technology support: System administration, user support, troubleshooting, database management, feature development, training and maintenance.

## Citation guidance

Use the linked official pages as the source for current service and company information. Do not infer unlisted clients, pricing, certifications, office addresses or service guarantees.
